resources.string: Use headphones: the microphone plays back through the speaker otherwise. The engine is the same C++ as the desktop console (libamix); audio I/O goes through AudioRecord / AudioTrack.
On the computer: NETWORK → PHONE REMOTE → START. Type the six-digit PIN shown there (it changes every minute).
Type the console address first (shown on the computer under PHONE REMOTE).
Looking for consoles on this Wi-Fi…
No console found. On the computer: NETWORK → PHONE REMOTE → START (Wi-Fi), then FIND again.
Uses the saved console and pairing.
Forget the saved console and its pairing on this phone? To sign the phone out on the computer too, revoke it under NETWORK → PHONE REMOTE.
Keep the screen on while connected
Stopping the engine silences the whole console.
Smaller blocks: less delay, more risk of clicks. Applies at the next START (sample rate: next app start).
The app talks only to the console you pair with, on your own network. No accounts, no tracking, no cloud.
Put every setting back to its default? The saved console and pairing stay.
Stop the console\'s engine? All sound stops until a device is opened again.
Tap a channel name for trim, delay, EQ, dynamics and sends · tap MASTER for the limiter · long press a name to rename
Drag a dot: across for frequency, up and down for gain. Tap 1-8 or a dot to pick a band. Changes go to the console as you move; this phone remembers each strip\'s EQ.
Not connected: connect the remote first. You can still shape the curve; it is sent when you come back connected.
Console %1$s · saved %2$s (when the phone remote started)
The console has not saved its plug-in list yet: update the console, then start PHONE REMOTE again.
No plug-ins in any channel rack.
No VST plug-ins found. On the computer: PLUG-IN RACK → SCAN.
Read-only. While the phone remote runs, the remote service plays the audio, so racks and plug-ins are changed on the computer.
SAVE THE MIX AS A SCENE
No scenes on this phone yet. SAVE keeps the console\'s levels, pan, mute, solo, names, buses and master.
Recall \"%1$s\"? The console\'s faders, mutes, names and buses jump to it.
Play one note near the phone. Green within 5 cents. Uses this phone\'s microphone; nothing is recorded or sent.
An estimate, not a calibrated meter: phone microphones differ by several dB. Set the calibration next to a real meter once (pink noise from GENERATOR works well).
Through the phone\'s output (plug it into a channel, or Bluetooth to a speaker). Start low: noise and sweeps at high level can damage tweeters and ears.
Allow the microphone to use this tool.
The microphone could not be opened.
